title: ytickangle
summary: Query or set Y-axis tick label rotation.

gpu_support.notes: `ytickangle` updates host-side axes metadata only and does not execute numeric GPU kernels.

description: `ytickangle` returns or updates the Y-axis tick label rotation in degrees for the current axes or specified axes handles.
behaviors: `ytickangle()` returns the current Y tick label rotation, defaulting to `0`.
`ytickangle(angle)` sets the current axes Y tick label rotation in degrees.
`ytickangle(ax)` queries a scalar axes handle without changing the current axes.
`ytickangle(ax, angle)` accepts a scalar axes handle or numeric array of axes handles and sets each target.
The function shares state with `YTickLabelRotation` on axes and `TickLabelRotation` on the Y-axis ruler returned by `get(ax, 'YAxis')`.
gpu_residency: `ytickangle` only reads and writes axes metadata. It does not inspect, gather, or transform GPU-resident plot data.
